report.summary: Both failures have one cause: the app accepts a publication year of next year (2027) and returns 201 instead of rejecting it. The server-side check at app/main.py:94 only behaves this way when the seeded `year_off_by_one` bug is enabled, and the CI workflow does not set BUGS, so first confirm where BUGS=year_off_by_one came from in this run's environment. If it was unintended, fix the runner config; if it was not, fix validate_book so next year is rejected.

causes.title: Year validation accepts next year (year_off_by_one behaviour)
causes.explanation: validate_book allows years up to this_year + 1 when the 'year_off_by_one' bug flag is in BUGS, so a book with year = current year + 1 is stored. The API test expects 422 and the UI test expects an inline error, so both fail because the book is created. The other invalid-input cases (blank title, empty author, year 0) still reject correctly, which fits a fault confined to the upper year bound. The test expectations match the spec in the app's own error message ('Year must be between 1 and <this year>').
evidence: tests/ui/test_books_ui.py:44: Locator expected to contain text 'Year must be between'; Actual value: None; element(s) not found
UI aria snapshot shows the row 'Future-56fcdf9f Someone 2027 Delete', so the book was saved with year 2027
app/main.py:94: max_year = this_year + 1 if "year_off_by_one" in BUGS else this_year
app/main.py:95-96: if not 1 <= book.year <= max_year: raise HTTPException(422, f"Year must be between 1 and {this_year}")
app/main.py:9 docstring: 'year_off_by_one  accepts next year as a publication year'
.github/workflows/tests.yml does not set BUGS, so the flag must come from the environment of the run (the app reads os.environ at app/main.py:31)
The passing test test_current_year_is_accepted and the rejected year-zero case show the rest of the year check works.
causes.suggested_fix: Make the year upper bound this_year in validate_book (remove the year_off_by_one branch from production code). Also check the CI job and runner environment for a stray BUGS variable so the suite runs against the correct app. Then rerun both tests, which should pass.
